descriptionEn: An apartment is offered for rent in Lakrishte, in the “BeniDona” building, Prishtina.

The apartment is located on the 10th floor of a modern building, served by two elevators and with access secured by key fobs, offering complete quiet, safety and comfort. The location is strategic, close to the centre, institutions, shopping centres and public transport.

The space includes a spacious living room with integrated kitchen, 3.5 bedrooms, bathroom and WC, a functional hallway and a balcony with an open view. The apartment has electric/radiator heating and air conditioning, is naturally lit and ready to move into, offering an urban setting with an ideal balance between quiet and dynamism.
extraCaptionsEn:
On the 10th floor, with 2 elevators and key fob access.
Living room with kitchen + 3.5 bedrooms, bathroom + WC, hallway and balcony with a view.

Electric / radiator heating + air conditioning.
Regular, urban space, ready for you.
📍 Lakrishtë – the heart of the city.
